author: bfonta
body:
When passing a single commit to `git-cms-cherry-pick`, `git diff` is computed between the commit and the working tree, leading to potentially many packages being added by `git-cms-addpkg`. When the commit being cherry-picked is relatively old, `git-cms-addpkg` can easily add dozens of packages, leading to an extremely slow compilation and crowded working directory.
This PR fixes the issue, by computing the commit difference with respect to the (mainline) commit's parent.

Tested locally with:

```bash
scram project -n GitTEST CMSSW_20_1_0_pre5
cd GitTEST/src/
cmsenv
git-cms-init
../../cms-git-tools/git-cms-cherry-pick <personal old commit hash> # use modified git-cms-cherry-pick
```

which prints only the modified packages after "Checking out packages".
title: Handle the single commit case
